description: Story, world and characters, down to the written dialogue, barks and item text. Produces the script and the lore bible; the voice rules live here too.
when_to_use: the request is about story, world, characters or written lines
dialogue or flavour text has to be written
the tone of the writing is inconsistent
avoid_when: the request is about how the text is displayed rather than what it says
the work is translating existing text
